result.reason: The cap and stated carve-outs track the preferred position, but the retained sentence stating that “under no circumstance” Licensor is liable for claims that use of the technology infringes or violates any rights creates a unilateral absolute exclusion. It conflicts with the purported uncapped carve-out for Licensor’s infringement of Licensee’s IP and may also override other excluded claims framed as violations of contractual or statutory rights. The consequential-damages provision also remains internally inconsistent because it is nominally mutual but refers only to whether Licensor was advised of the potential loss. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but the operative language does not achieve a coherent mutual limitation regime.
